articleBodyHtml:
High Confidence Claims

Several claims have been identified with high confidence. These include: 'Shane bathed the speaker's wife.' ('He bathed your wife.'), 'No one cares about him.' ('Okay.' and 'No one cares about me.'), 'They repeated the phrase 'There we went'.' ('There we went.'), 'The speaker is worried about a character having 'death flags'.' ('he's, he has some death flags...'), and 'It was cute.' ('Exactly. See. See it was cute.' and 'It was very cute. Okay. Bye everyone. See you all soon. Bye.').
